BiblicalUsage: Abi is named once, in 2 Kings 18:2, as the mother of Hezekiah: 'his mother's name was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.' She is the queen mother at the start of the best king's reign — named in one verse, and never again.
TheologicalSignificance: A mother named once, at the door of her son's reign, and the text moves on. I believe Abi's single verse honours something the Bible does again and again: the mothers behind the kings, named and remembered, even when the story belongs to their sons.
